description:
Extend the calibration sweep to `polynomial.karatsuba_min_degree` once the polynomial selectors read the tuning profile.

## Background

The calibration action of issue `5ecc9bf8` sweeps four of the five v1 profile fields. `karatsuba_min_degree` is not sweepable from a bench target in the tree that issue lands against: a bench links `gf2-core` as an external crate, so it can name only `pub` items, and both arms of this crossover are private — `mul_schoolbook_impl` at `crates/gf2-core/src/field/poly.rs:2484` and `mul_karatsuba_raw` at `:2531`. The only public entry is `FieldPoly::mul`, which picks one arm from the compiled-in `KARATSUBA_THRESHOLD`. The module documents the omission deliberately at `crates/gf2-core/src/field/poly.rs:72`: "There is no standalone `pub fn mul_karatsuba`: the schoolbook <-> Karatsuba crossover is internal". No grid point therefore offers both arms, and the design's §2.7 rule 2 is undecidable for this field.

Per design `dev/active/220cab0b/design.md` §5 condition 5, `5ecc9bf8`'s emitted profile omits the field, so it inherits the conservative default at load rather than claiming an unmeasured value. That is a tracked limitation, recorded with its numbers in that issue's calibration receipt, not a defect in the emitted artifact.

Issue `697fc55b` makes `mul_impl` resolve the threshold from `tuning::active()`. After it lands, both arms become reachable without new public API: a child process that installs a profile with a minimal `karatsuba_min_degree` takes the Karatsuba arm at every grid point, and one that installs a maximal value takes the schoolbook arm, so the same public `FieldPoly::mul` yields both arms on one grid.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The calibration harness sweeps `karatsuba_min_degree` across a grid straddling `KARATSUBA_THRESHOLD`, obtaining both arms at each grid point by forcing the selection through an installed profile rather than by adding public API to `crates/gf2-core/src/field/poly.rs`.
- [hard] REQ-02: The emitted profile carries a calibrated `karatsuba_min_degree` selected by the design's §2.7 rule, and the receipt records the sweep including any tie or non-monotone case and the default it fell back to.
- [hard] REQ-03: The limitation recorded in `5ecc9bf8`'s receipt is updated or superseded so no committed record still states the field is unsweepable.
title: Extend the calibration sweep to karatsuba_min_degree after the polynomial cutover
